selection_policy.documents: Four already parsed PageIndex-OSS PDFs with visible ToCs: 3 financial reports and 1 manual, 75–198 pages; convenience cohort, not representative sampling.
selection_policy.questions: Retain all eight questions from the prior OSS subset, then select 12 existing V2 annotations to reach five per document, adding table and multi-page evidence. No new questions or labels generated. Selection frozen before this cohort's runs.
selection_policy.scope: Answerable text/table evidence only. Parsed supporting pages inspected before execution. Formula/count questions test retrieval of the cited inputs, not answer calculation. No image-only or absent-evidence cases in this cohort.
selection_policy.annotation_limit: Reference pages are the upstream annotation, not all possible valid evidence locations; exact page recall can penalize alternative/repeated evidence.
